profiles.biography: Brandon Spidel is a color guard and general-effect adjudicator from Indianapolis who has been involved in the pageantry arts since 1989 as a performer, instructor, clinician, and designer. He aged out of DCI as a euphonium player in 1996, earned a Bachelor of Science in Music Education from Indiana State University, and has been an Indiana band director since 1998. He judges the General Effect caption for Winter Guard International (since 2024) and is an adjudicator for Drum Corps International, Bands of America, and various color guard and marching band circuits.

profiles.biography: Kim (Corney) Kuhn is a visual adjudicator with over 24 years in the pageantry arts as a performer, designer, director, instructor, and clinician, having worked with groups appearing in BOA, DCI, and WGI semifinals and finals. She is an active visual judge for Drum Corps International, Bands of America, and Winter Guard International as well as fall marching band and winter circuits, and continues to design, consult, and provide technician work for fall and winter programs. She has served on the board of the Michigan Color Guard Circuit and is its Vice President of Color Guards, focused on training and education for performers and directors.

profiles.biography: Tom Slaughter is a visual adjudicator with 43 years in the pageantry arts as a performer, designer, instructor, and judge for Drum Corps International, Winter Guard International, and various marching band circuits. A member of the Suncoast Sound drum and bugle corps, he designed and administered the visual program at Largo High School (Largo, FL) for 17 years, winning Florida class championships in 1998 and 2000, was Visual Caption Head and Staff Coordinator for the Teal Sound drum corps (2009-2011), and was on the Blue Stars visual staff in 2012. He has served as a Visual Analysis judge at DCI World Championships (including 2022 and 2025) and is a Florida Federation Color Guard Circuit Hall of Fame member.

facts.fact: 43 yrs pageantry; Suncoast Sound; Largo HS visual director 17 yrs; Teal Sound visual caption head; Blue Stars 2012; FFCC HOF; DCI visual judge

profiles.biography: Warren Rickart is an internationally recognized marching band and winter guard adjudicator and clinician who has judged for Winter Guard International, Drum Corps International, and Bands of America world championships and regional and international competitions for over 25 years. A member of the Madison Scouts drum and bugle corps and Miller's Blackhawks winter guard, he has been visual caption head, color guard caption head, clinician, and consultant for numerous award-winning programs. He has served on the WGI Judge Administration team and as WGI Equipment/Movement caption manager, was former chief judge of the Southern States Judges Association and Education Director for the Atlantic Indoor Association (Hall of Honor, 2008), and judged Color Guard at the 2024 DCI World Championship Semifinals.

profiles.biography: Bryan Crisp is a brass/music adjudicator, trumpet player, and marching arts consultant who holds undergraduate degrees in Music Education and Music Performance from Tennessee Technological University and a Master of Music in Trumpet Performance from the University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music. He has held Instructor of Trumpet positions at Wittenberg University, Mount St. Joseph University, CCM, and the Tennessee Governor's School for the Arts, and is Founder and Artistic Director of Tri-State Ensembles, a chamber-music program for high school students. He is an active adjudicator for Drum Corps International, Bands of America, KMEA, ISSMA, ITG, and the National Trumpet Competition, serving in the Music Brass caption at DCI World Championships, and is a Yamaha artist.

facts.fact: TTU + CCM trumpet degrees; trumpet instructor (Wittenberg/Mount St. Joseph/CCM); Tri-State Ensembles founder; DCI Music Brass judge; Yamaha artist

profiles.biography: Jodie Ann Rhodes is a music/general-effect adjudicator who has been involved in music education for over 30 years as a clinician, consultant, and program designer/coordinator for marching bands, drum corps, and concert bands, with groups that are frequent finalists and champions at state championships and BOA Regionals, Super Regionals, and Grand Nationals. She has served as a General Effect judge at DCI World Championships (General Effect 2 in 2024, General Effect in 2025).

facts.fact: 30+ yrs music educator; clinician/designer/coordinator; DCI General Effect judge 2024/2025

profiles.biography: Garland 'Gary' Euel Markham III was a Hall of Fame music educator and adjudicator whose engagement with Drum Corps International spanned more than four decades. He joined the staff of the Blue Devils in the mid-1970s and later the Spirit of Atlanta as a music arranger and program coordinator, became a DCI judge in 1980, and was named Education Advisor for DCI's Rules and Systems Task Force, becoming a steadfast voice in the refinement of the adjudication system and a champion of judge training. He was inducted into the DCI Hall of Fame (2022) and also received the Sousa Foundation Sudler Order of Merit (1992), the Music for All Hall of Fame (2006), and the Conn-Selmer Institute Hall of Fame (2015). He died in 2022 at age 75.

facts.fact: DCI HOF 2022; DCI judge since 1980; Education Advisor for Rules & Systems Task Force; Blue Devils & Spirit of Atlanta; d. 2022

profiles.biography: Shawn Halquist is a brass/music adjudicator and lifelong music educator with nearly 50 years in band direction and performance design, who retired in 2022 after a 38-year career as a high school band director. After degrees from Edinboro University and SUNY Binghamton, he taught 13 years in the Millcreek Township School District (Erie, PA) and 25 years at Brockport (NY) Central Schools. He judges for Drum Corps International, the New York State Field Band Conference, the Pennsylvania Federation of Contest Judges, Cavalcade of Bands, and other circuits, serving as a Music Brass judge at DCI World Championships (including the 2024 All-Age and 2025 events), and designs shows and writes arrangements for all levels.

facts.fact: ~50 yrs music education; retired 2022 after 38-yr HS band director career (Millcreek PA, Brockport NY); DCI Music Brass judge

profiles.biography: Dr. JR Carlisle is a visual adjudicator who has judged for Winter Guard International, Drum Corps International, and Bands of America in 38 states, as well as Drum Corps Europe's Championships and the drum corps competition in Kyoto, Japan. He has served as chief judge for the Nebraska Bandmasters Association and as Education Director/Chief Judge for the CIPA Circuit, and is a founding member of the Tri-State Circuit for the Pageantry Arts. He has directed WGI Regional finalist and national semifinalist color guards and drum lines, and resides in Point Pleasant, West Virginia.
